topic_candidates.query: OpenAI Exponential Time Hypothesis false Lean proof October 2026 P versus NP explanation
topic_candidates.brief: Explain the difference between a famous computer-science assumption and the much bigger P-versus-NP problem. OpenAI says an internal AI system produced a sub-exponential algorithm for a hard satisfiability problem and formalized it in Lean, but independent researchers still need to check the mathematics. The ordinary-person takeaway is that this is a potentially important change to what researchers thought was difficult—not proof that computers can instantly solve every puzzle or break encryption.
topic_candidates.evidence_summary: OpenAI says its system produced a result concerning the Exponential Time Hypothesis and released a formalized Lean version for public scrutiny. Independent coverage emphasizes that refuting ETH would not by itself prove P=NP, make all hard problems easy or automatically defeat modern encryption. ([openai.com](https://openai.com/index/building-scientific-understanding-with-academic-communities/?utm_source=openai))
topic_candidates.science_angle: Computational complexity, sub-exponential algorithms, satisfiability problems, formal verification and the limits of what an ETH result would imply.
